full_prompt_en: A close 35 mm color-slide photograph studies a small branch of autumn leaves in a dark woodland. The nearest leaves hang at the left and center, turning from wine red through magenta to luminous orange along their veins and edges. One five-lobed leaf sits below center as the clearest point of attention, while additional leaves drift out of focus behind it. Thin almost black twigs cross the image diagonally. In the distance, a broad tree trunk and scattered blue-white gaps of sky dissolve into a cool, soft background. Late light catches the upper leaf surfaces in tiny silvery flecks and warms the translucent red foliage, but the lower part of the frame stays deeply shaded. The palette is rich and concentrated: crimson, coral-orange, violet, midnight blue, and a few cyan sky spots. The color contrast is vivid without being flat; every leaf retains fine veins, mottling, and slight weathering. Focus is selective, favoring the central leaf group and allowing the background to become large rounded patches. Slight film grain and the faint dark border of a slide frame lend an analog feel. The composition avoids perfect symmetry: a brighter leaf pulls downward while the branching network opens toward the upper right. Dark negative space around the warm leaves gives their color room to glow. The image feels intimate and slightly mysterious, preserving a brief transition from daylight into the blue shadow of evening.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅近距离35毫米彩色反转片摄影观察暗林中一小枝秋叶。最近的叶片垂在左侧和中心，由酒红经洋红转为叶脉与边缘上发亮的橙。一片五裂叶位于中心偏下，成为最清晰的焦点，更多叶在背后失焦漂浮。几根近黑细枝斜穿画面。远处，宽树干和蓝白天空的散落缝隙融入冷而柔的背景。晚光抓住上方叶面的小银点，并温暖半透的红叶，但画框下部保持深影。配色浓郁集中：绯红、珊瑚橙、紫罗兰、午夜蓝和少量青蓝天空点。颜色对比鲜明却不平板；每片叶都保留细叶脉、斑驳和轻微风化。焦点有选择地偏向中央叶群，让背景成为大而圆的色斑。轻胶片颗粒与反转片画框的淡暗边带来模拟质感。构图避开完美对称：较亮叶片把视线向下拉，枝网朝右上打开。暖叶周围的暗留白让颜色有发光空间。画面亲密且略神秘，保留日光转入傍晚蓝影的短暂过程。
style_prompt_en: Color-slide photography creates vivid but nuanced separation between warm translucent accents and cool deep surroundings. Crimson, magenta, coral-orange, violet-blue, and small cyan highlights occupy distinct patches, with saturated color concentrated in the nearer lit layer. Selective focus holds fine veins and mottled surface on a small central cluster, while background shapes dissolve into broad soft bokeh. Thin dark diagonals connect the planes. Light skims and penetrates semi-translucent material, producing luminous edges and tiny silvery specular marks; lower regions remain almost black but retain hints of texture. A faint film border, subtle grain, and slight color depth make the image feel analog rather than digitally polished. The composition balances uneven bright fragments against generous cool negative space. Its rhythm moves from crisp warm detail through shadowed branching lines to soft blue distance, creating a saturated, intimate twilight atmosphere.
style_prompt_zh: 彩色反转片摄影在暖半透强调与冷深周围之间创造鲜明而细腻的分离。绯红、洋红、珊瑚橙、紫蓝和少量青蓝亮点占据各自色片，饱和色集中在近处受光层。选择性焦点让小片中央簇群的细脉与斑驳表面清楚，背景则溶为宽阔柔散景。细暗斜线连接各平面。光擦过并穿透半透材质，产生发亮边缘与微小银色镜面点；下部近黑，却仍留一丝纹理。淡胶片边框、细颗粒和轻微色彩深度使图像有模拟质感，而非数码光洁。构图以不均匀亮碎片平衡宽大冷留白。节奏从清晰暖细节经过遮阴枝线到柔蓝远方，营造饱和、亲密的暮色氛围。
theme_en: Red autumn leaves catch the last light against a cool woodland dusk
theme_zh: 红色秋叶在冷色林地黄昏中接住最后的光
name: Fujichrome Provia 100F
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
